##############################################################################
#                                                                            #
#   PixelPlus settings  -  pixelplus.txt                                     #
#                                                                            #
#   Edit this file on any computer (Notepad, TextEdit, ...) BEFORE you put   #
#   the SD card in your Raspberry Pi. PixelPlus reads it every time it       #
#   starts and applies anything you changed.                                 #
#                                                                            #
#   How to edit:                                                             #
#     * Type your value right after the "=" sign, e.g.  wifi_ssid=MyHome     #
#     * Lines starting with "#" are notes and are ignored.                   #
#     * Leave a value empty to keep the current setting.                     #
#     * Everything after "=" is used exactly as typed (spaces inside are     #
#       fine). If your value starts or ends with a space, put it in          #
#       "double quotes".                                                     #
#                                                                            #
#   Passwords are removed from this file once they have been applied (they  #
#   are stored safely on the device). To change one, just type a new one.    #
#                                                                            #
#   If something here is wrong, PixelPlus writes "pixelplus-errors.txt"      #
#   next to this file explaining what to fix.                                #
#                                                                            #
##############################################################################


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Wi-Fi
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The name of your Wi-Fi network (it is case sensitive: "MyHome" is not
# "myhome"). Leave empty if you use an Ethernet cable, or if you want to pick
# the network from your phone (see "Setup hotspot" below).
wifi_ssid=Chandler Home

# The Wi-Fi password. Leave empty for an open network.
wifi_password="  pa ss#word  "

# Two-letter country code where the Pi is used, e.g. US, GB, CA, DE, AU, NZ.
# Wi-Fi needs this to use the right radio channels.
wifi_country=US

# Set to "yes" if your network is hidden (does not broadcast its name).
wifi_hidden=no

# Optional: a second network to try, e.g. your phone's hotspot or the
# network at the place where the show runs.
wifi2_ssid=
wifi2_password=


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This controller
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The name of this controller on your network. You will open it in a browser
# at  http://<hostname>.local  (for example http://pixelplus.local).
# Use letters, numbers and dashes only, e.g.  pixelplus-garage
# Give every controller in your show a different name!
hostname=pixelplus-garage

# What this controller does in your show:
#   leader    - the main controller. It holds the show, plays the music and
#               tells every other controller what to do. You need exactly one.
#   follower  - an extra controller that is set up from the leader.
# Leave empty to choose in the browser the first time you open PixelPlus.
role=follower

# Your time zone, e.g. America/New_York, America/Chicago, America/Denver,
# America/Los_Angeles, Europe/London, Australia/Sydney.
# The schedule (and "sunset" show times) use it. Leave empty to set it later
# in the browser.
timezone=America/Chicago

# Which PixelPlus board is attached. Normally "auto": PixelPlus reads the
# board's memory chip. Only set this if auto-detection fails:
#   auto, difftx, difftxlarge, diffsmart, bare-pi
board=auto


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Fixed IP address (optional - most people leave this empty)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Leave ip_address empty to keep the current setting (a new card uses DHCP =
# automatic). Type "dhcp" to go back to automatic after using a fixed address.
# Example:  ip_address=192.168.1.50/24   ip_gateway=192.168.1.1   ip_dns=192.168.1.1
ip_address=
ip_gateway=
ip_dns=
# Which connection gets the fixed address: wifi or ethernet.
# Empty = wifi if wifi_ssid is set, otherwise ethernet.
ip_interface=


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Security
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Password for the PixelPlus web page. Empty = no password (fine on a home
# network). You can also set or change it later in Settings -> Security.
ui_password=letmein1

# SSH remote login for advanced users: on or off. Empty = keep as is (a new
# PixelPlus card has SSH off). The login user is "pi" unless you created a
# different user with Raspberry Pi Imager.
ssh=on
# Password for the login user (at least 8 characters).
ssh_password=sshpassword
# Or/and a public key, e.g.  ssh_key=ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3Nz... me@laptop
ssh_key=


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Setup hotspot
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# If PixelPlus cannot join a Wi-Fi network (and no network cable is plugged
# in) it opens its own Wi-Fi network called "PixelPlus-XXXX" (XXXX is unique
# to each Pi). Join it with your phone: a setup page pops up where you pick
# your Wi-Fi network and type its password.
#
# on  - open the setup hotspot when there is no network (recommended)
# off - never open it
hotspot=on

# Password of the setup hotspot (8 to 63 characters). The default is
#   pixelplus
# Use "none" for an open hotspot without a password.
hotspot_password=pixelplus

# Seconds to wait for Wi-Fi at power-on before opening the hotspot.
hotspot_timeout=75
